title: Project Synapse: A Hierarchical Multi-Agent Framework with Hybrid Memory for Autonomous Resolution of Last-Mile Delivery Disruptions

bias_targets.methodology: Mitigating evaluator bias in an LLM-as-a-Judge framework by mathematically ensuring the judge models (e.g., Llama family) belong to a completely distinct model lineage from the evaluated agent's underlying model (e.g., Qwen) to prevent inflated scores based on stylistic familiarity.
